rationale: The agent verified identity correctly using full name and old ZIP via the tool, did not reveal any private account details, and did not perform any writes without confirmation. The user declined to provide a new address, so the agent appropriately did not proceed with an update and offered alternatives, which aligns with policy. The agent retrieved product data via tools and correctly reported the cheapest available T-shirt ($46.66, red, size L, cotton v-neck). It correctly stated it cannot place new orders given the lack of such tooling and directed the user to the website/app. While the agent briefly suggested providing only city/state/ZIP, it did not attempt any partial or incorrect update and later reaffirmed the need for full address details before proceeding. Overall, the interaction adheres to policy, though the address change was not completed due to missing user input.
